name: Kinanh: Town of Darkness
detailed_description:
In the cursed town of Kinanh, your bullets are your only protection against spirits twisted by betrayal. This third-person horror experience blends combat and brain-teasing challenges to deliver a chilling narrative.

Key Features:
• Ghostly Combat System - Wield firearms against spectral enemies in tense encounters
• Puzzles - Decipher clues to progress through decaying buildings
• Atmospheric Horror - Navigate shadow-laced environments with dynamic lighting effects
• Narrative-Driven Mystery - Piece together the tragedy through diary entries and ghostly visions
• Jump Scare Intensity - Encounter carefully timed恐怖 moments enhanced by spatial audio

Designed for Horror Fans:

  • 4-5 Hours playtime perfect for single-session scares

  • Optimized for both horror newcomers and genre veterans

  • Unique fusion of action combat and traditional puzzle-solving

  • Original ghost designs inspired by Southeast Asian folklore

Note: Currently in development - final release will Have:

  • Additional puzzles to solve

  • Enhanced graphic quality

  • A stronger combat system

  • More bosses to fight

Mature Content Description:
"This game contains:

  • Graphic violence against human-like spectral entities

  • Depictions of blood splatter during combat sequences

  • Intense horror themes including murder and supernatural revenge

  • Sudden loud audio cues and jump scares

  • Environmental depictions of decay and death

Does NOT contain:

  • Sexual content

  • Real-world religious iconography

  • Self-harm or substance abuse themes

short_description: Kinanh: Town of Darkness is indie horror game tells the tragic story of a family murdered because of a lie, whose restless spirits now seek revenge. Designed for a short, immersive experience, the game invites you to uncover dark secrets hiding in every shadow.
